summary: The macOS release bundle builds and passes strict deep code-signature integrity verification as an ad-hoc universal app. No Developer ID team signature is configured, so signed-release Keychain persistence and installed-app acceptance remain unverified.

checks.name: macOS release build
checks.observation: Built desktop/build/macos/Build/Products/Release/BOOHTACORD.app with Flutter 3.47.5 and Xcode 27.0; the bundle contains x86_64 and arm64 slices and occupies 90,384 KiB. Third-party deprecation/precision warnings were emitted, but the build succeeded.

checks.name: Release bundle signature integrity
checks.observation: All nested frameworks and the app bundle are valid on disk and satisfy the ad-hoc designated requirement. Bundle identifier is ru.boohtacord.boohtacordDesktop. Signature has no TeamIdentifier.

checks.name: Developer ID persistence and installed-app acceptance
checks.observation: This machine produced an ad-hoc signature only. Successful login/session write and read after relaunch in a Developer ID-signed release remains unverified.

remaining: Configure or use the macOS Developer ID signing identity, then verify authenticated session persistence across relaunch and runtime behavior from the signed release app.
